summary_paragraph: The patient was admitted for abdominal pain and vomiting with dark emesis. Evaluation revealed stable renal transplant function, no acute abdominal pathology on imaging, and negative H. pylori and CMV tests. Her pain improved with Maalox/lidocaine and symptom management. Labs showed stable kidney function and chronic anemia. She was discharged home with improved symptoms, a plan for GI follow-up, and continuation of essential medications including tacrolimus, antihypertensives, and darbepoetin. Medication simplification was recommended due to polypharmacy.
